abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe the epidemiologic characteristics of gynecologic malignancies in patients 25 years of age or younger. METHODS: The Automated Central Tumor Registry (ACTUR), the cancer registry for the Department of Defense, was used to identify children, adolescents, and young adults diagnosed with gynecologic malignancies. Specifically, primary ovarian, uterine, cervical, vaginal, and vulvar malignancies diagnosed between 1990 and 2002 were included in the analysis. Data from the Department of Defense tumor registry were then compared with results obtained from the national Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Report (SEER) program database. RESULTS: Two hundred fifty-one cases were identified in the Department of Defense tumor registry. The most common primary site was ovary, with 116 cases (46%), followed by cervix, with 108 cases (43%). The most common histological types were germ cell (35%) for ovary, squamous cell (52%) for cervix, choriocarcinoma (18%) for uterus, and squamous cell (30%) for vulva/vagina. The 21- to 25-year-old age group had the greatest number of cases for the entire cohort (23%). Most patients had only local disease at time of diagnosis, and the 5-year survival percentage was 86% (95% confidence interval 80-91) for all patients with ovarian and cervical carcinoma. Data from the SEER program demonstrated a similar distribution and incidence pattern. CONCLUSION: The ovary and cervix are the most common primary sites of gynecologic malignancies in patients 25 years of age or younger. Health maintenance programs for patients in this age group should continue to include pelvic exams and Pap test screening.
abstract_ja: 目的:25歳以下の患者における婦人科悪性腫瘍の疫学的特徴を記述すること。方法:国防総省の腫瘍登録であるAutomated Central Tumor Registry(ACTUR)を用いて、小児、青年、若年成人の婦人科悪性腫瘍症例を同定した。1990年から2002年に診断された原発性卵巣、子宮、子宮頸部、腟、外陰の悪性腫瘍を解析の対象とした。国防総省腫瘍登録のデータは、全国的なSEER(Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results)プログラムのデータベースの結果と比較された。結果:国防総省腫瘍登録で251例が同定された。最も多い原発部位は卵巣で116例(46%)、次いで子宮頸部で108例(43%)であった。最も多い組織型は、卵巣では胚細胞腫瘍(35%)、子宮頸部では扁平上皮癌(52%)、子宮では絨毛癌(18%)、外陰・腟では扁平上皮癌(30%)であった。21～25歳の年齢群が全体で最も多く(23%)、大部分の患者は診断時に局所病変のみであった。卵巣および子宮頸部癌のすべての患者の5年生存率は86%(95%信頼区間80-91)であった。SEERプログラムのデータも同様の分布と発生パターンを示した。結論:25歳以下の婦人科悪性腫瘍で最も多い原発部位は卵巣と子宮頸部である。この年齢層の健康管理プログラムには、引き続き骨盤内診察とパップ検査によるスクリーニングを含めるべきである。
